def resonance_analysis(hypotheses, scores):
    best_idx = np.argmax(scores)
    return hypotheses[best_idx], scores[best_idx]

best_hypothesis, best_score = resonance_analysis(hypotheses, scores)
print(f"Best hypothesis: {best_hypothesis}, score: {best_score:.2f}")

source: ## 🧮 Step 7: Clustering Example

# Generate synthetic data
X = np.random.randn(300, 2)
X[:100] += [3, 3]
X[100:200] += [0, -4]
X[200:] += [-3, 3]

# Clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42)
labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X)

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=labels, cmap='viridis', s=50)
plt.title("Clustering of Data")
plt.xlabel("Feature 1")
plt.ylabel("Feature 2")
plt.show()
## 🧮 Step 8: Cluster Quality Evaluation

# Distance to nearest cluster center
distances = pairwise_distances_argmin_min(X, kmeans.cluster_centers_)[1]
intra_cluster_variance = np.mean(distances)
print(f"Average intra-cluster variance: {intra_cluster_variance:.2f}")
## 📊 Step 9: Resonance Points Visualization

# Hypothetical "resonance points"
resonance_points = kmeans.cluster_centers_

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=labels, cmap='viridis', s=30, alpha=0.6)
plt.scatter(resonance_points[:, 0], resonance_points[:, 1], c='red', s=200, marker='X', label="Resonance Points")
plt.title("Resonance Points in Clusters")
plt.legend()
plt.xlabel("Feature 1")
plt.ylabel("Feature 2")
plt.show()
## 📈 Step 10: Compare with Baseline Constraints
print(f"KMeans iterations: {kmeans.n_iter_}")
print(f"Maximum allowed iterations: {constraints['max_iterations']}")
